issue.title: M1: Rust macOS AX adapter — native-verified window control
issue.body:
Stage M1 per `docs/MACOS-TAHOE-NEXT-STAGE.md`: smallest Rust macOS AX adapter proof, native-verified on the owner host.

## What
- `crates/platform-macos`: pure-FFI adapter over ApplicationServices + CoreFoundation (no external deps; depends on `hypr-rust-layout-core` only). All `unsafe` confined to `ffi.rs` + documented wrappers in `adapter.rs`.
- Safe API: `MacAxAdapter::{connect, main_window, window_frame, set_window_frame, raise}`; typed `AxError` (PermissionDenied / StaleTarget / Unsupported / IllegalArgument / NoWindows / Failure(code)); AXError-code mapping verified against host HIServices (macOS 26.7.1).
- `ax-probe` CLI for native tests: frame / set-frame (read-back ≤1pt) / raise; exit 3 = permission, 4 = stale.

## Native evidence (host, AX granted, self-owned target only)
- frame read (100,668) 420×312; move ×3 + resize 480×320 — exact read-back; raise ok; killed pid → exit 4 StaleTarget (prompt, typed).
- fmt/clippy clean; 8/8 tests pass.
- Full verbatim report: `docs/reports/MACOS-M1-AX-ADAPTER-2026-10-18.md`.

## Honest limitations
- Permission-denied path: code path exists (connect gate); **not runtime tested** — host holds AX trust; revoking would break the test environment.
- Single 1.0x display; multi-display/multi-DPI not tested.
- Host identity conflict (system `MacBookPro16,2` vs owner ThinkPad X13 Yoga) reconciled in report §1.
- No private APIs, no Spaces/workspace code, no global loop, no startup service, no title logging.

## Test plan
- [x] `cargo fmt --check` OK
- [x] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean
- [x] `cargo test --workspace` 8/8 pass
- [x] Native: frame/move×3/resize/raise/stale on self-owned target
- [ ] Permission-denied runtime (marked not tested — see report §6)

comment.body:
## Round-4 review — all 4 findings addressed

| Commit | Content |
|---|---|
| `3d3df82` | adapter + probe code (lock fail-open fix) |
| `136f1e1` | docs: EWOULDBLOCK-only, spike head, mock count |

Branch head = `136f1e1` (adapter code = `3d3df82`; docs in the following commit, no self-referential SHA). Spike = `0eb9a25`.

**1. Lock fail-open (important) — fixed.** `verify_fixture_lock` now accepts **only** `EWOULDBLOCK`/`EAGAIN` (lock contention) as "held by a live fixture". Any other `flock` error (EBADF, EINVAL, EINTR, …) is rejected — fail closed. Added `K_ERRNO_EWOULDBLOCK` + errno check after `flock`.

**2. Rollback not atomic — documented honestly.** AX is not transactional: if AX refuses the restore write, a partial state may remain. The code already reports this (`rollback_restored=false` + best-known frame) but cannot guarantee atomicity. Added an explicit limitation in report §7: this is an inherent AX boundary, not a code bug. No code change possible — AX has no transactional primitive.

**3. Unused helpers + token print — fixed.** Removed the unused `axSize`/`axSetPoint`/`axSetSize` Swift helpers (no CLI path called them after `run-tests` was removed). The harness no longer prints the raw token to stdout; it prints a pointer to the owner-only registration file, so the token never appears in captured output. Report/brief reconciled (token redacted in docs; read from file).

**4. Mock test count — corrected.** The report said 10; the correct count is **9** transaction-contract mock tests (6 non-transaction + 9 transaction = 15 platform-macos; + 6 workspace = 21). Fixed in report §3/§4/§5/§6/§7 and arena brief C12.

**Validation (verbatim, host macOS 26.7.1):**
- fmt/clippy clean; tests **21/21** (6 workspace + 15 platform-macos).
- Native rerun after the lock fix: frame read-only ok · no-token → exit 5 · set-frame ×2 with token → ok · stale → exit 4. Lock still held while alive, freed on death.

Requesting a re-review from **arena.ai**. Not merging; still an M1 adapter proof. Evidence: `docs/reports/MACOS-M1-AX-ADAPTER-2026-10-18.md` (§5 rerun, §6 F1/F1b/F2, §7 limitations) and `docs/ARENA-VERIFICATION.md` (claims C11/C12/C13, heads `spike=0eb9a25`, `M1=3d3df82`).

comment.body:
## M1 closeout packet — F1/F1b/F2 all addressed

Reviewed the arena readiness packet (`hypr-rust#2.zip`). Two commits on the branch:

| Commit | Content |
|---|---|
| `4176c0f` | adapter + probe code (F1b/F2) |
| `661b8bd` | docs: redacted rerun + arena brief |

Branch head = `661b8bd` (adapter code = `4176c0f`; docs in the following commit, no self-referential SHA).

**F1 — Swift mutating path removed.** `run-tests --pid` and `runTests()` deleted from the spike harness (PR #1, `5d16063`). Swift is now a fixture spawner + read-only probe only; the Rust `ax-probe` is the sole mutator. No Swift path mutates an arbitrary PID.

**F1b — lifecycle-bounded, PID-reuse-resistant registration.** Redesigned fail-closed:
- `~/.hypr-rust/` (0700) + `fixture-target.json` (0600, regular non-symlink, atomic temp+rename) + `fixture.lock`.
- Process-instance identity = **exclusive flock held by the fixture for its whole lifetime**. The probe refuses mutation unless the lock is held, so a stale record or reused PID cannot authorize mutation. (macOS has no public process-start-time API — `proc_pidinfo`/libproc is marked private and the sysctl `extern_proc` layout is not in public headers — so the flock is the public, robust identity.)
- Registration removed on normal termination; abrupt death releases the flock → probe rejects (verified: lock freed on fixture death).
- Probe verification: lstat (regular non-symlink) + uid match + perm 0600 + pid/token match + pid alive + flock held. Any failure → exit 5 before any AX call.

**F2 — rollback on all post-mutation failures.** `set_window_frame` now rolls back fully (position + size) and verifies on **every** post-mutation failure: `PositionWriteFailed`, `SizeAfterPositionFailed`, `VerificationReadFailed` (read-back error), `VerificationFailed` (mismatch). Each preserves the original cause, rollback status, and best-known observed frame; rollback failure is never reported as "unchanged". Returns the verified frame; the CLI's redundant post-transaction read is removed. Write/read orchestration refactored behind a `FrameOps` trait with 10 mock unit tests (labelled mock, not native).

**Validation (verbatim, host macOS 26.7.1):**
- fmt/clippy clean; tests **21/21** (6 workspace + 15 platform-macos).
- Native rerun (token redacted): frame read-only ok · set-frame **without token → exit 5** · raise **without token → exit 5** · set-frame ×3 with token → ok · resize → ok · raise → ok · invalid geometry → exit 1 (window unchanged) · stale → exit 4 · **old token after fixture death → rejected** (liveness + flock backstop).
- All read-backs matched. Forced rollback-denial paths are mock-tested only (no public AX switch) — marked honestly in report §7.

Requesting a re-review from **arena.ai**. Not merging; still an M1 adapter proof. Evidence: `docs/reports/MACOS-M1-AX-ADAPTER-2026-10-18.md` (§5 rerun, §6 F1/F1b/F2 table) and `docs/ARENA-VERIFICATION.md` (claims C11/C12/C13, heads `spike=5d16063`, `M1=4176c0f`).

comment.body:
## Review round 2 — F1/F2 closed (token-gated mutation + read-back verification)

Two commits on the branch:

| Commit | Content |
|---|---|
| `41a8867` | adapter + probe code (F1/F2) |
| `998ead8` | docs: report rerun + arena brief |

Branch head = `998ead8` (adapter code = `41a8867`; the SHA is not self-referential — docs live in the following commit).

**F1 — mutation limited to the registered self-owned target.** `set-frame` / `raise` now require `--target <pid> --token <hex>`. The probe verifies the registration file `/tmp/hypr-rust-target.json` (written by the spike harness at `spawn-target`, perm `0600`) before any AX call: file exists, permissions exactly `0600`, pid + token match, pid alive. Missing/mismatched identity → exit 5, before any AX mutation. `frame` stays read-only and token-free. The harness commit is on PR #1 (`5500727`).

**F2 — read-back verification + rollback in `set_window_frame`.** Geometry is preflighted with `Rect::is_finite_and_positive()` (core). After both writes are accepted the frame is read back and compared within 1pt; on mismatch the saved geometry is fully rolled back (position + size) and verified, returning `VerificationFailed { expected, actual, rollback_restored }`. Pure `frames_match()` + unit test.

**Validation (verbatim, host macOS 26.7.1):**
- `cargo fmt --check` + `cargo clippy --workspace/--manifest-path ... -D warnings` → clean
- tests: **12/12** (6 workspace layout-core + 6 platform-macos)
- native rerun (token flow): frame read-only ok · set-frame **without token → exit 5** · raise **without token → exit 5** · set-frame ×3 with token → ok · resize → ok · raise → ok · invalid geometry → exit 1 (window unchanged) · stale → exit 4

All read-backs matched; the forced-mismatch path (`VerificationFailed`) is unit-tested but not runtime-forced (no public AX switch) — marked honestly in the report §7.

Requesting a re-review from **arena.ai**. Not merging; this remains an M1 adapter proof, not general macOS support. Evidence: `docs/reports/MACOS-M1-AX-ADAPTER-2026-10-18.md` (§5 rerun, §6 F1/F2 table) and `docs/ARENA-VERIFICATION.md` (claims C11/C12, heads `spike=5500727`, `M1=41a8867`).

comment.body:
## Review response — all 6 findings addressed

Branch synced with `main`, fixes committed (`8540e55` → branch head `f13141f`). fmt/clippy/test rerun post-merge: **11/11 pass** (6 workspace + 5 platform-macos). Native rerun on the Tahoe host after the fixes: frame/move×3/resize/raise identical to the first run; stale exit 4.

| Finding | Fix |
|---|---|
| P1 partial mutation in `set_window_frame` | Preflight `validate_frame_rect` (finite, positive) → `AxError::InvalidGeometry` before any write; geometry saved before first write; on size-write failure the position is rolled back and verified by read-back; `SizeAfterPositionFailed` reports explicitly whether rollback restored. **Live-tested**: NaN and zero-size rejected (exit 1) with the window unchanged; rollback path itself not runtime-exercisable (no public switch to force AX to refuse the second write) — logic + pure helpers unit-tested, stated in report §5 |
| P1 macOS crate in workspace | `platform-macos` removed from `members`; empty `[workspace]` table makes it standalone. `cargo build/test --workspace` is now Windows-safe; macOS crate built/tested via its own manifest (report §4, brief §4) |
| P2 CF leak on success path | `CFRelease(app)` after window ownership transfers to `AxWindow`; every exit path now releases `app` exactly once |
| P2 AXWindows fallback | `is_missing_main_window()`: `noValue`/`attributeUnsupported` fall back to the window list; permission/stale/cannotComplete/illegal still propagate |
| P2 repro references missing file | Report §8 now fetches the harness from the spike branch via `git show`; commands split workspace vs macOS crate |
| P2 EPERM ≡ dead | `process_alive_from_kill()` reads errno: only `ESRCH` means stale; `EPERM` (alive, other user) and other errnos assume alive so AX surfaces the real error |

Report updated: `docs/reports/MACOS-M1-AX-ADAPTER-2026-10-18.md` §4 (split commands), §5 (post-review rerun), §6 (review mapping table). Arena brief v2: `docs/ARENA-VERIFICATION.md` (claims C9–C10 added).

Host-bound items unchanged and still marked: permission-denied path **not runtime tested**; Windows 11 not verified; Hackintosh identity is host evidence (no serials/UUIDs/EFI configs recorded).
